change_entity_chain: Entity.OnChangeEntity 0x06013799 constructs LoadCardData(updateActor=ShouldUpdateActorOnChangeEntity, restartStateSpells=ShouldRestartStateSpellsOnChangeEntity, fromChangeEntity=true).

ShouldUpdateActorOnChangeEntity 0x0601379c returns true only on CARDTYPE202/PREMIUM12/LETTUCE_MERCENARY1665 changes or signature frame change. All thirteen current normal minions to normal Sheep keep these values; SignatureFrameWillChange 0x0601379b returns false unless premium==3.

ShouldRestartStateSpellsOnChangeEntity 0x0601379d special Battleground enemy coin gate is absent; ordinary fallback is ELITE114 changed. All thirteen are nonlegendary and Sheep is nonlegendary, so false.
HandleEntityChange 0x060137af creates TagDeltaList before applying the new tags, deactivates custom keyword effects, destroys prior CardDef-owned effects, and calls LoadCard with async=false.

Entity.OnCardDefLoaded 0x06013875 passes updateActor=false to Card.SetCardDef 0x06012d22; that calls existing Actor.SetCardDef then UpdateAllComponents(true). It does not replace/destroy the actor or reset its status Spell table.

The callback skips UpdateActor and ActivateStateSpells when both flags are false. It marks m_loadState=3 before returning. HandleEntityChange then dispatches the collected tag deltas via OnTagsChanged.

production_contract.no_rules_changes: Do not modify historical transform mechanics or RNG; this is presentation-only binding.
production_contract.no_wait_for_old_taunt: Do not use the actual-actor-path-replacement coroutine or delay new Sheep visuals for its taunt callback. That coroutine is not reached for these thirteen mappings.
production_contract.reuse_lookup: Find a mappings row with exact from_card_id and to_card_id. Do not extend this rule to future identities without source audit.
production_contract.visible_transform: Preserve Actor/root and status identity. Refresh portrait/stat fields, retire only frozen and taunt via genuine source Death if their booleans were cleared, keep sleep if predicate unchanged.

actor_reuse.scope: Only current normal nonpremium thirteen minion identities transforming to CS2_tk1. Both sides, same board slot/controller/entity identity. No unsupported modern/alternate frames.
source_path_chain: Card.DetermineActorPathForZone 0x06012e9b -> ActorNames.GetZoneActor 0x060129e7 -> overload 0x060129e6, Play zone1 -> GetPlayActorByTags 0x060129f3.

Card type4 normal minion, not Lettuce, chooses actor kind7. GetNameWithPremiumType 0x060129fc selects s_actorAssets for premium0. ActorNames..cctor 0x06012a02 IL0067..006d binds kind7 to the identical Card_Play_Ally GUID.

The CardDef portrait/material/class changes do not define a different standard play Actor path. Same Actor holds the new CardDef via Actor.SetCardDef 0x06012807; normal UpdateAllComponents 0x0601285e updates text/materials/textures/mesh without ReleaseSpells.

state_decisions.corruption: Remove gameplay corruption marking per existing historical transform rules; no persistent source skull/status asset or extra status sound is introduced.
state_decisions.frozen: If FROZEN260 1->0, dispatch ordinary type14 Death on the same status instance and run the recovered thaw audio. No minion-death 0.3 phase delay; transformation is a tag change.
state_decisions.hidden: An unrelated actual temporary Actor.Hide still gates tag visual dispatch, as described in hidden_actor_semantics.json. Do not infer that Polymorph causes a Hide: the recovered CS2_022 start/impact routes contain no target Actor.Hide/Show action.
state_decisions.sleep: Current rules preserve summoning_sick and attacks_used; all thirteen source minions and Sheep lack Charge. Thus IsAsleep predicate remains unchanged. Preserve existing sleep instance/serial/timeline and only update its subject card ID/portrait binding. Do not emit Death/Birth merely because the card ID changed.
state_decisions.taunt: If TAUNT190 1->0, TagVisualConfiguration.ActivateStateFunction(TAUNT,false) 0x06014baf IL006c..0072 calls no-argument Actor.DeactivateTaunt 0x06012952, which checks active type8 and calls ActivateSpellDeathState at IL000b. Run the recovered shield-break audio once. No replacement-only callback/wait branch.
state_decisions.unchanged: No lifecycle event solely from card ID changes. Preserve status roots not removed by real tag/predicate changes.

tag_delta_dispatch: HandleEntityChange 0x060137af: CreateDeltas IL000c -> SetTags IL0019 -> LoadCard(async=false) IL0053 -> OnTagsChanged IL0102.

Entity.OnTagsChanged 0x060137a2 -> Card.OnTagsChanged 0x06012d77. Non-stat tags FROZEN260/TAUNT190/NUM_TURNS271 dispatch Card.OnTagChanged 0x06012d7b, whose IL001b calls TagVisualConfiguration.ProcessTagChange.

ProcessTagChange 0x06014bac uses source m_TagRemoved when old!=0,new==0. The relevant config entries have m_IgnoreCanShowActorVisuals=0. The synchronous CardDef loading callback has completed, so an otherwise shown target passes the gate.

update_actor_parameter_proof.same_path_gate: An existing non-LettuceAbilityActor with m_actorPath==resolvedActorPath returns at IL005a before prefab instantiation or old-actor cleanup.

ShouldUpdateActorOnChangeEntity 0x0601379c returns true only on CARDTYPE202/PREMIUM12/LETTUCE_MERCENARY1665 changes or signature frame change. All thirteen current normal minions to normal Sheep keep these values; SignatureFrameWillChange 0x0601379b returns false unless premium==3.

ShouldRestartStateSpellsOnChangeEntity 0x0601379d special Battleground enemy coin gate is absent; ordinary fallback is ELITE114 changed. All thirteen are nonlegendary and Sheep is nonlegendary, so false.
HandleEntityChange 0x060137af creates TagDeltaList before applying the new tags, deactivates custom keyword effects, destroys prior CardDef-owned effects, and calls LoadCard with async=false.

Entity.OnCardDefLoaded 0x06013875 passes updateActor=false to Card.SetCardDef 0x06012d22; that calls existing Actor.SetCardDef then UpdateAllComponents(true). It does not replace/destroy the actor or reset its status Spell table.

The callback skips UpdateActor and ActivateStateSpells when both flags are false. It marks m_loadState=3 before returning. HandleEntityChange then dispatches the collected tag deltas via OnTagsChanged.

production_contract.no_rules_changes: Do not modify historical transform mechanics or RNG; this is presentation-only binding.
production_contract.no_wait_for_old_taunt: Do not use the actual-actor-path-replacement coroutine or delay new Sheep visuals for its taunt callback. That coroutine is not reached for these thirteen mappings.
production_contract.reuse_lookup: Find a mappings row with exact from_card_id and to_card_id. Do not extend this rule to future identities without source audit.
production_contract.visible_transform: Preserve Actor/root and status identity. Refresh portrait/stat fields, retire only frozen and taunt via genuine source Death if their booleans were cleared, keep sleep if predicate unchanged.

actor_reuse.scope: Only current normal nonpremium thirteen minion identities transforming to CS2_tk1. Both sides, same board slot/controller/entity identity. No unsupported modern/alternate frames.
source_path_chain: Card.DetermineActorPathForZone 0x06012e9b -> ActorNames.GetZoneActor 0x060129e7 -> overload 0x060129e6, Play zone1 -> GetPlayActorByTags 0x060129f3.

Card type4 normal minion, not Lettuce, chooses actor kind7. GetNameWithPremiumType 0x060129fc selects s_actorAssets for premium0. ActorNames..cctor 0x06012a02 IL0067..006d binds kind7 to the identical Card_Play_Ally GUID.

The CardDef portrait/material/class changes do not define a different standard play Actor path. Same Actor holds the new CardDef via Actor.SetCardDef 0x06012807; normal UpdateAllComponents 0x0601285e updates text/materials/textures/mesh without ReleaseSpells.

state_decisions.corruption: Remove gameplay corruption marking per existing historical transform rules; no persistent source skull/status asset or extra status sound is introduced.
state_decisions.frozen: If FROZEN260 1->0, dispatch ordinary type14 Death on the same status instance and run the recovered thaw audio. No minion-death 0.3 phase delay; transformation is a tag change.
state_decisions.hidden: An unrelated actual temporary Actor.Hide still gates tag visual dispatch, as described in hidden_actor_semantics.json. Do not infer that Polymorph causes a Hide: the recovered CS2_022 start/impact routes contain no target Actor.Hide/Show action.
state_decisions.sleep: Current rules preserve summoning_sick and attacks_used; all thirteen source minions and Sheep lack Charge. Thus IsAsleep predicate remains unchanged. Preserve existing sleep instance/serial/timeline and only update its subject card ID/portrait binding. Do not emit Death/Birth merely because the card ID changed.
state_decisions.taunt: If TAUNT190 1->0, TagVisualConfiguration.ActivateStateFunction(TAUNT,false) 0x06014baf IL006c..0072 calls no-argument Actor.DeactivateTaunt 0x06012952, which checks active type8 and calls ActivateSpellDeathState at IL000b. Run the recovered shield-break audio once. No replacement-only callback/wait branch.
state_decisions.unchanged: No lifecycle event solely from card ID changes. Preserve status roots not removed by real tag/predicate changes.

tag_delta_dispatch: HandleEntityChange 0x060137af: CreateDeltas IL000c -> SetTags IL0019 -> LoadCard(async=false) IL0053 -> OnTagsChanged IL0102.

Entity.OnTagsChanged 0x060137a2 -> Card.OnTagsChanged 0x06012d77. Non-stat tags FROZEN260/TAUNT190/NUM_TURNS271 dispatch Card.OnTagChanged 0x06012d7b, whose IL001b calls TagVisualConfiguration.ProcessTagChange.

ProcessTagChange 0x06014bac uses source m_TagRemoved when old!=0,new==0. The relevant config entries have m_IgnoreCanShowActorVisuals=0. The synchronous CardDef loading callback has completed, so an otherwise shown target passes the gate.

update_actor_parameter_proof.same_path_gate: An existing non-LettuceAbilityActor with m_actorPath==resolvedActorPath returns at IL005a before prefab instantiation or old-actor cleanup.

change_entity_chain: Entity.OnChangeEntity 0x06013799 constructs LoadCardData(updateActor=ShouldUpdateActorOnChangeEntity, restartStateSpells=ShouldRestartStateSpellsOnChangeEntity, fromChangeEntity=true).

ShouldUpdateActorOnChangeEntity 0x0601379c returns true only on CARDTYPE202/PREMIUM12/LETTUCE_MERCENARY1665 changes or signature frame change. All thirteen current normal minions to normal Sheep keep these values; SignatureFrameWillChange 0x0601379b returns false unless premium==3.

ShouldRestartStateSpellsOnChangeEntity 0x0601379d special Battleground enemy coin gate is absent; ordinary fallback is ELITE114 changed. All thirteen are nonlegendary and Sheep is nonlegendary, so false.
HandleEntityChange 0x060137af creates TagDeltaList before applying the new tags, deactivates custom keyword effects, destroys prior CardDef-owned effects, and calls LoadCard with async=false.

Entity.OnCardDefLoaded 0x06013875 passes updateActor=false to Card.SetCardDef 0x06012d22; that calls existing Actor.SetCardDef then UpdateAllComponents(true). It does not replace/destroy the actor or reset its status Spell table.

The callback skips UpdateActor and ActivateStateSpells when both flags are false. It marks m_loadState=3 before returning. HandleEntityChange then dispatches the collected tag deltas via OnTagsChanged.

production_contract.no_rules_changes: Do not modify historical transform mechanics or RNG; this is presentation-only binding.
production_contract.no_wait_for_old_taunt: Do not use the actual-actor-path-replacement coroutine or delay new Sheep visuals for its taunt callback. That coroutine is not reached for these thirteen mappings.
production_contract.reuse_lookup: Find a mappings row with exact from_card_id and to_card_id. Do not extend this rule to future identities without source audit.
production_contract.visible_transform: Preserve Actor/root and status identity. Refresh portrait/stat fields, retire only frozen and taunt via genuine source Death if their booleans were cleared, keep sleep if predicate unchanged.

actor_reuse.scope: Only current normal nonpremium thirteen minion identities transforming to CS2_tk1. Both sides, same board slot/controller/entity identity. No unsupported modern/alternate frames.
source_path_chain: Card.DetermineActorPathForZone 0x06012e9b -> ActorNames.GetZoneActor 0x060129e7 -> overload 0x060129e6, Play zone1 -> GetPlayActorByTags 0x060129f3.

Card type4 normal minion, not Lettuce, chooses actor kind7. GetNameWithPremiumType 0x060129fc selects s_actorAssets for premium0. ActorNames..cctor 0x06012a02 IL0067..006d binds kind7 to the identical Card_Play_Ally GUID.

The CardDef portrait/material/class changes do not define a different standard play Actor path. Same Actor holds the new CardDef via Actor.SetCardDef 0x06012807; normal UpdateAllComponents 0x0601285e updates text/materials/textures/mesh without ReleaseSpells.

state_decisions.corruption: Remove gameplay corruption marking per existing historical transform rules; no persistent source skull/status asset or extra status sound is introduced.
state_decisions.frozen: If FROZEN260 1->0, dispatch ordinary type14 Death on the same status instance and run the recovered thaw audio. No minion-death 0.3 phase delay; transformation is a tag change.
state_decisions.hidden: An unrelated actual temporary Actor.Hide still gates tag visual dispatch, as described in hidden_actor_semantics.json. Do not infer that Polymorph causes a Hide: the recovered CS2_022 start/impact routes contain no target Actor.Hide/Show action.
state_decisions.sleep: Current rules preserve summoning_sick and attacks_used; all thirteen source minions and Sheep lack Charge. Thus IsAsleep predicate remains unchanged. Preserve existing sleep instance/serial/timeline and only update its subject card ID/portrait binding. Do not emit Death/Birth merely because the card ID changed.
state_decisions.taunt: If TAUNT190 1->0, TagVisualConfiguration.ActivateStateFunction(TAUNT,false) 0x06014baf IL006c..0072 calls no-argument Actor.DeactivateTaunt 0x06012952, which checks active type8 and calls ActivateSpellDeathState at IL000b. Run the recovered shield-break audio once. No replacement-only callback/wait branch.
state_decisions.unchanged: No lifecycle event solely from card ID changes. Preserve status roots not removed by real tag/predicate changes.

tag_delta_dispatch: HandleEntityChange 0x060137af: CreateDeltas IL000c -> SetTags IL0019 -> LoadCard(async=false) IL0053 -> OnTagsChanged IL0102.

Entity.OnTagsChanged 0x060137a2 -> Card.OnTagsChanged 0x06012d77. Non-stat tags FROZEN260/TAUNT190/NUM_TURNS271 dispatch Card.OnTagChanged 0x06012d7b, whose IL001b calls TagVisualConfiguration.ProcessTagChange.

ProcessTagChange 0x06014bac uses source m_TagRemoved when old!=0,new==0. The relevant config entries have m_IgnoreCanShowActorVisuals=0. The synchronous CardDef loading callback has completed, so an otherwise shown target passes the gate.

update_actor_parameter_proof.same_path_gate: An existing non-LettuceAbilityActor with m_actorPath==resolvedActorPath returns at IL005a before prefab instantiation or old-actor cleanup.

change_entity_chain: Entity.OnChangeEntity 0x06013799 constructs LoadCardData(updateActor=ShouldUpdateActorOnChangeEntity, restartStateSpells=ShouldRestartStateSpellsOnChangeEntity, fromChangeEntity=true).

ShouldUpdateActorOnChangeEntity 0x0601379c returns true only on CARDTYPE202/PREMIUM12/LETTUCE_MERCENARY1665 changes or signature frame change. All thirteen current normal minions to normal Sheep keep these values; SignatureFrameWillChange 0x0601379b returns false unless premium==3.

ShouldRestartStateSpellsOnChangeEntity 0x0601379d special Battleground enemy coin gate is absent; ordinary fallback is ELITE114 changed. All thirteen are nonlegendary and Sheep is nonlegendary, so false.
HandleEntityChange 0x060137af creates TagDeltaList before applying the new tags, deactivates custom keyword effects, destroys prior CardDef-owned effects, and calls LoadCard with async=false.

Entity.OnCardDefLoaded 0x06013875 passes updateActor=false to Card.SetCardDef 0x06012d22; that calls existing Actor.SetCardDef then UpdateAllComponents(true). It does not replace/destroy the actor or reset its status Spell table.

The callback skips UpdateActor and ActivateStateSpells when both flags are false. It marks m_loadState=3 before returning. HandleEntityChange then dispatches the collected tag deltas via OnTagsChanged.

production_contract.no_rules_changes: Do not modify historical transform mechanics or RNG; this is presentation-only binding.
production_contract.no_wait_for_old_taunt: Do not use the actual-actor-path-replacement coroutine or delay new Sheep visuals for its taunt callback. That coroutine is not reached for these thirteen mappings.
production_contract.reuse_lookup: Find a mappings row with exact from_card_id and to_card_id. Do not extend this rule to future identities without source audit.
production_contract.visible_transform: Preserve Actor/root and status identity. Refresh portrait/stat fields, retire only frozen and taunt via genuine source Death if their booleans were cleared, keep sleep if predicate unchanged.

actor_reuse.scope: Only current normal nonpremium thirteen minion identities transforming to CS2_tk1. Both sides, same board slot/controller/entity identity. No unsupported modern/alternate frames.
source_path_chain: Card.DetermineActorPathForZone 0x06012e9b -> ActorNames.GetZoneActor 0x060129e7 -> overload 0x060129e6, Play zone1 -> GetPlayActorByTags 0x060129f3.

Card type4 normal minion, not Lettuce, chooses actor kind7. GetNameWithPremiumType 0x060129fc selects s_actorAssets for premium0. ActorNames..cctor 0x06012a02 IL0067..006d binds kind7 to the identical Card_Play_Ally GUID.

The CardDef portrait/material/class changes do not define a different standard play Actor path. Same Actor holds the new CardDef via Actor.SetCardDef 0x06012807; normal UpdateAllComponents 0x0601285e updates text/materials/textures/mesh without ReleaseSpells.

state_decisions.corruption: Remove gameplay corruption marking per existing historical transform rules; no persistent source skull/status asset or extra status sound is introduced.
state_decisions.frozen: If FROZEN260 1->0, dispatch ordinary type14 Death on the same status instance and run the recovered thaw audio. No minion-death 0.3 phase delay; transformation is a tag change.
state_decisions.hidden: An unrelated actual temporary Actor.Hide still gates tag visual dispatch, as described in hidden_actor_semantics.json. Do not infer that Polymorph causes a Hide: the recovered CS2_022 start/impact routes contain no target Actor.Hide/Show action.
state_decisions.sleep: Current rules preserve summoning_sick and attacks_used; all thirteen source minions and Sheep lack Charge. Thus IsAsleep predicate remains unchanged. Preserve existing sleep instance/serial/timeline and only update its subject card ID/portrait binding. Do not emit Death/Birth merely because the card ID changed.
state_decisions.taunt: If TAUNT190 1->0, TagVisualConfiguration.ActivateStateFunction(TAUNT,false) 0x06014baf IL006c..0072 calls no-argument Actor.DeactivateTaunt 0x06012952, which checks active type8 and calls ActivateSpellDeathState at IL000b. Run the recovered shield-break audio once. No replacement-only callback/wait branch.
state_decisions.unchanged: No lifecycle event solely from card ID changes. Preserve status roots not removed by real tag/predicate changes.

tag_delta_dispatch: HandleEntityChange 0x060137af: CreateDeltas IL000c -> SetTags IL0019 -> LoadCard(async=false) IL0053 -> OnTagsChanged IL0102.

Entity.OnTagsChanged 0x060137a2 -> Card.OnTagsChanged 0x06012d77. Non-stat tags FROZEN260/TAUNT190/NUM_TURNS271 dispatch Card.OnTagChanged 0x06012d7b, whose IL001b calls TagVisualConfiguration.ProcessTagChange.

ProcessTagChange 0x06014bac uses source m_TagRemoved when old!=0,new==0. The relevant config entries have m_IgnoreCanShowActorVisuals=0. The synchronous CardDef loading callback has completed, so an otherwise shown target passes the gate.

update_actor_parameter_proof.same_path_gate: An existing non-LettuceAbilityActor with m_actorPath==resolvedActorPath returns at IL005a before prefab instantiation or old-actor cleanup.

renderer.validation: Source GPU draft. CPU equations/projection independently verified; actual GPU targets/order/raster/quantization require QA capture.

change_entity_chain: Entity.OnChangeEntity 0x06013799 constructs LoadCardData(updateActor=ShouldUpdateActorOnChangeEntity, restartStateSpells=ShouldRestartStateSpellsOnChangeEntity, fromChangeEntity=true).

ShouldUpdateActorOnChangeEntity 0x0601379c returns true only on CARDTYPE202/PREMIUM12/LETTUCE_MERCENARY1665 changes or signature frame change. All thirteen current normal minions to normal Sheep keep these values; SignatureFrameWillChange 0x0601379b returns false unless premium==3.

ShouldRestartStateSpellsOnChangeEntity 0x0601379d special Battleground enemy coin gate is absent; ordinary fallback is ELITE114 changed. All thirteen are nonlegendary and Sheep is nonlegendary, so false.
HandleEntityChange 0x060137af creates TagDeltaList before applying the new tags, deactivates custom keyword effects, destroys prior CardDef-owned effects, and calls LoadCard with async=false.

Entity.OnCardDefLoaded 0x06013875 passes updateActor=false to Card.SetCardDef 0x06012d22; that calls existing Actor.SetCardDef then UpdateAllComponents(true). It does not replace/destroy the actor or reset its status Spell table.

The callback skips UpdateActor and ActivateStateSpells when both flags are false. It marks m_loadState=3 before returning. HandleEntityChange then dispatches the collected tag deltas via OnTagsChanged.

production_contract.no_rules_changes: Do not modify historical transform mechanics or RNG; this is presentation-only binding.
production_contract.no_wait_for_old_taunt: Do not use the actual-actor-path-replacement coroutine or delay new Sheep visuals for its taunt callback. That coroutine is not reached for these thirteen mappings.
production_contract.reuse_lookup: Find a mappings row with exact from_card_id and to_card_id. Do not extend this rule to future identities without source audit.
production_contract.visible_transform: Preserve Actor/root and status identity. Refresh portrait/stat fields, retire only frozen and taunt via genuine source Death if their booleans were cleared, keep sleep if predicate unchanged.

actor_reuse.scope: Only current normal nonpremium thirteen minion identities transforming to CS2_tk1. Both sides, same board slot/controller/entity identity. No unsupported modern/alternate frames.
source_path_chain: Card.DetermineActorPathForZone 0x06012e9b -> ActorNames.GetZoneActor 0x060129e7 -> overload 0x060129e6, Play zone1 -> GetPlayActorByTags 0x060129f3.

Card type4 normal minion, not Lettuce, chooses actor kind7. GetNameWithPremiumType 0x060129fc selects s_actorAssets for premium0. ActorNames..cctor 0x06012a02 IL0067..006d binds kind7 to the identical Card_Play_Ally GUID.

The CardDef portrait/material/class changes do not define a different standard play Actor path. Same Actor holds the new CardDef via Actor.SetCardDef 0x06012807; normal UpdateAllComponents 0x0601285e updates text/materials/textures/mesh without ReleaseSpells.

state_decisions.corruption: Remove gameplay corruption marking per existing historical transform rules; no persistent source skull/status asset or extra status sound is introduced.
state_decisions.frozen: If FROZEN260 1->0, dispatch ordinary type14 Death on the same status instance and run the recovered thaw audio. No minion-death 0.3 phase delay; transformation is a tag change.
state_decisions.hidden: An unrelated actual temporary Actor.Hide still gates tag visual dispatch, as described in hidden_actor_semantics.json. Do not infer that Polymorph causes a Hide: the recovered CS2_022 start/impact routes contain no target Actor.Hide/Show action.
state_decisions.sleep: Current rules preserve summoning_sick and attacks_used; all thirteen source minions and Sheep lack Charge. Thus IsAsleep predicate remains unchanged. Preserve existing sleep instance/serial/timeline and only update its subject card ID/portrait binding. Do not emit Death/Birth merely because the card ID changed.
state_decisions.taunt: If TAUNT190 1->0, TagVisualConfiguration.ActivateStateFunction(TAUNT,false) 0x06014baf IL006c..0072 calls no-argument Actor.DeactivateTaunt 0x06012952, which checks active type8 and calls ActivateSpellDeathState at IL000b. Run the recovered shield-break audio once. No replacement-only callback/wait branch.
state_decisions.unchanged: No lifecycle event solely from card ID changes. Preserve status roots not removed by real tag/predicate changes.

tag_delta_dispatch: HandleEntityChange 0x060137af: CreateDeltas IL000c -> SetTags IL0019 -> LoadCard(async=false) IL0053 -> OnTagsChanged IL0102.

Entity.OnTagsChanged 0x060137a2 -> Card.OnTagsChanged 0x06012d77. Non-stat tags FROZEN260/TAUNT190/NUM_TURNS271 dispatch Card.OnTagChanged 0x06012d7b, whose IL001b calls TagVisualConfiguration.ProcessTagChange.

ProcessTagChange 0x06014bac uses source m_TagRemoved when old!=0,new==0. The relevant config entries have m_IgnoreCanShowActorVisuals=0. The synchronous CardDef loading callback has completed, so an otherwise shown target passes the gate.

update_actor_parameter_proof.same_path_gate: An existing non-LettuceAbilityActor with m_actorPath==resolvedActorPath returns at IL005a before prefab instantiation or old-actor cleanup.

ShouldRestartStateSpellsOnChangeEntity 0x0601379d special Battleground enemy coin gate is absent; ordinary fallback is ELITE114 changed. All thirteen are nonlegendary and Sheep is nonlegendary, so false.
HandleEntityChange 0x060137af creates TagDeltaList before applying the new tags, deactivates custom keyword effects, destroys prior CardDef-owned effects, and calls LoadCard with async=false.

Entity.OnCardDefLoaded 0x06013875 passes updateActor=false to Card.SetCardDef 0x06012d22; that calls existing Actor.SetCardDef then UpdateAllComponents(true). It does not replace/destroy the actor or reset its status Spell table.

The callback skips UpdateActor and ActivateStateSpells when both flags are false. It marks m_loadState=3 before returning. HandleEntityChange then dispatches the collected tag deltas via OnTagsChanged.

production_contract.no_rules_changes: Do not modify historical transform mechanics or RNG; this is presentation-only binding.
production_contract.no_wait_for_old_taunt: Do not use the actual-actor-path-replacement coroutine or delay new Sheep visuals for its taunt callback. That coroutine is not reached for these thirteen mappings.
production_contract.reuse_lookup: Find a mappings row with exact from_card_id and to_card_id. Do not extend this rule to future identities without source audit.
production_contract.visible_transform: Preserve Actor/root and status identity. Refresh portrait/stat fields, retire only frozen and taunt via genuine source Death if their booleans were cleared, keep sleep if predicate unchanged.

actor_reuse.scope: Only current normal nonpremium thirteen minion identities transforming to CS2_tk1. Both sides, same board slot/controller/entity identity. No unsupported modern/alternate frames.
source_path_chain: Card.DetermineActorPathForZone 0x06012e9b -> ActorNames.GetZoneActor 0x060129e7 -> overload 0x060129e6, Play zone1 -> GetPlayActorByTags 0x060129f3.

Card type4 normal minion, not Lettuce, chooses actor kind7. GetNameWithPremiumType 0x060129fc selects s_actorAssets for premium0. ActorNames..cctor 0x06012a02 IL0067..006d binds kind7 to the identical Card_Play_Ally GUID.

The CardDef portrait/material/class changes do not define a different standard play Actor path. Same Actor holds the new CardDef via Actor.SetCardDef 0x06012807; normal UpdateAllComponents 0x0601285e updates text/materials/textures/mesh without ReleaseSpells.

state_decisions.corruption: Remove gameplay corruption marking per existing historical transform rules; no persistent source skull/status asset or extra status sound is introduced.
state_decisions.frozen: If FROZEN260 1->0, dispatch ordinary type14 Death on the same status instance and run the recovered thaw audio. No minion-death 0.3 phase delay; transformation is a tag change.
state_decisions.hidden: An unrelated actual temporary Actor.Hide still gates tag visual dispatch, as described in hidden_actor_semantics.json. Do not infer that Polymorph causes a Hide: the recovered CS2_022 start/impact routes contain no target Actor.Hide/Show action.
state_decisions.sleep: Current rules preserve summoning_sick and attacks_used; all thirteen source minions and Sheep lack Charge. Thus IsAsleep predicate remains unchanged. Preserve existing sleep instance/serial/timeline and only update its subject card ID/portrait binding. Do not emit Death/Birth merely because the card ID changed.
state_decisions.taunt: If TAUNT190 1->0, TagVisualConfiguration.ActivateStateFunction(TAUNT,false) 0x06014baf IL006c..0072 calls no-argument Actor.DeactivateTaunt 0x06012952, which checks active type8 and calls ActivateSpellDeathState at IL000b. Run the recovered shield-break audio once. No replacement-only callback/wait branch.
state_decisions.unchanged: No lifecycle event solely from card ID changes. Preserve status roots not removed by real tag/predicate changes.

tag_delta_dispatch: HandleEntityChange 0x060137af: CreateDeltas IL000c -> SetTags IL0019 -> LoadCard(async=false) IL0053 -> OnTagsChanged IL0102.

Entity.OnTagsChanged 0x060137a2 -> Card.OnTagsChanged 0x06012d77. Non-stat tags FROZEN260/TAUNT190/NUM_TURNS271 dispatch Card.OnTagChanged 0x06012d7b, whose IL001b calls TagVisualConfiguration.ProcessTagChange.

ProcessTagChange 0x06014bac uses source m_TagRemoved when old!=0,new==0. The relevant config entries have m_IgnoreCanShowActorVisuals=0. The synchronous CardDef loading callback has completed, so an otherwise shown target passes the gate.

update_actor_parameter_proof.same_path_gate: An existing non-LettuceAbilityActor with m_actorPath==resolvedActorPath returns at IL005a before prefab instantiation or old-actor cleanup.

change_entity_chain: Entity.OnChangeEntity 0x06013799 constructs LoadCardData(updateActor=ShouldUpdateActorOnChangeEntity, restartStateSpells=ShouldRestartStateSpellsOnChangeEntity, fromChangeEntity=true).

ShouldUpdateActorOnChangeEntity 0x0601379c returns true only on CARDTYPE202/PREMIUM12/LETTUCE_MERCENARY1665 changes or signature frame change. All thirteen current normal minions to normal Sheep keep these values; SignatureFrameWillChange 0x0601379b returns false unless premium==3.

ShouldRestartStateSpellsOnChangeEntity 0x0601379d special Battleground enemy coin gate is absent; ordinary fallback is ELITE114 changed. All thirteen are nonlegendary and Sheep is nonlegendary, so false.
HandleEntityChange 0x060137af creates TagDeltaList before applying the new tags, deactivates custom keyword effects, destroys prior CardDef-owned effects, and calls LoadCard with async=false.

Entity.OnCardDefLoaded 0x06013875 passes updateActor=false to Card.SetCardDef 0x06012d22; that calls existing Actor.SetCardDef then UpdateAllComponents(true). It does not replace/destroy the actor or reset its status Spell table.

The callback skips UpdateActor and ActivateStateSpells when both flags are false. It marks m_loadState=3 before returning. HandleEntityChange then dispatches the collected tag deltas via OnTagsChanged.

production_contract.no_rules_changes: Do not modify historical transform mechanics or RNG; this is presentation-only binding.
production_contract.no_wait_for_old_taunt: Do not use the actual-actor-path-replacement coroutine or delay new Sheep visuals for its taunt callback. That coroutine is not reached for these thirteen mappings.
production_contract.reuse_lookup: Find a mappings row with exact from_card_id and to_card_id. Do not extend this rule to future identities without source audit.
production_contract.visible_transform: Preserve Actor/root and status identity. Refresh portrait/stat fields, retire only frozen and taunt via genuine source Death if their booleans were cleared, keep sleep if predicate unchanged.

actor_reuse.scope: Only current normal nonpremium thirteen minion identities transforming to CS2_tk1. Both sides, same board slot/controller/entity identity. No unsupported modern/alternate frames.
source_path_chain: Card.DetermineActorPathForZone 0x06012e9b -> ActorNames.GetZoneActor 0x060129e7 -> overload 0x060129e6, Play zone1 -> GetPlayActorByTags 0x060129f3.

Card type4 normal minion, not Lettuce, chooses actor kind7. GetNameWithPremiumType 0x060129fc selects s_actorAssets for premium0. ActorNames..cctor 0x06012a02 IL0067..006d binds kind7 to the identical Card_Play_Ally GUID.

The CardDef portrait/material/class changes do not define a different standard play Actor path. Same Actor holds the new CardDef via Actor.SetCardDef 0x06012807; normal UpdateAllComponents 0x0601285e updates text/materials/textures/mesh without ReleaseSpells.

state_decisions.corruption: Remove gameplay corruption marking per existing historical transform rules; no persistent source skull/status asset or extra status sound is introduced.
state_decisions.frozen: If FROZEN260 1->0, dispatch ordinary type14 Death on the same status instance and run the recovered thaw audio. No minion-death 0.3 phase delay; transformation is a tag change.
state_decisions.hidden: An unrelated actual temporary Actor.Hide still gates tag visual dispatch, as described in hidden_actor_semantics.json. Do not infer that Polymorph causes a Hide: the recovered CS2_022 start/impact routes contain no target Actor.Hide/Show action.
state_decisions.sleep: Current rules preserve summoning_sick and attacks_used; all thirteen source minions and Sheep lack Charge. Thus IsAsleep predicate remains unchanged. Preserve existing sleep instance/serial/timeline and only update its subject card ID/portrait binding. Do not emit Death/Birth merely because the card ID changed.
state_decisions.taunt: If TAUNT190 1->0, TagVisualConfiguration.ActivateStateFunction(TAUNT,false) 0x06014baf IL006c..0072 calls no-argument Actor.DeactivateTaunt 0x06012952, which checks active type8 and calls ActivateSpellDeathState at IL000b. Run the recovered shield-break audio once. No replacement-only callback/wait branch.
state_decisions.unchanged: No lifecycle event solely from card ID changes. Preserve status roots not removed by real tag/predicate changes.

tag_delta_dispatch: HandleEntityChange 0x060137af: CreateDeltas IL000c -> SetTags IL0019 -> LoadCard(async=false) IL0053 -> OnTagsChanged IL0102.

Entity.OnTagsChanged 0x060137a2 -> Card.OnTagsChanged 0x06012d77. Non-stat tags FROZEN260/TAUNT190/NUM_TURNS271 dispatch Card.OnTagChanged 0x06012d7b, whose IL001b calls TagVisualConfiguration.ProcessTagChange.

ProcessTagChange 0x06014bac uses source m_TagRemoved when old!=0,new==0. The relevant config entries have m_IgnoreCanShowActorVisuals=0. The synchronous CardDef loading callback has completed, so an otherwise shown target passes the gate.

update_actor_parameter_proof.same_path_gate: An existing non-LettuceAbilityActor with m_actorPath==resolvedActorPath returns at IL005a before prefab instantiation or old-actor cleanup.

change_entity_chain: Entity.OnChangeEntity 0x06013799 constructs LoadCardData(updateActor=ShouldUpdateActorOnChangeEntity, restartStateSpells=ShouldRestartStateSpellsOnChangeEntity, fromChangeEntity=true).

ShouldUpdateActorOnChangeEntity 0x0601379c returns true only on CARDTYPE202/PREMIUM12/LETTUCE_MERCENARY1665 changes or signature frame change. All thirteen current normal minions to normal Sheep keep these values; SignatureFrameWillChange 0x0601379b returns false unless premium==3.

ShouldRestartStateSpellsOnChangeEntity 0x0601379d special Battleground enemy coin gate is absent; ordinary fallback is ELITE114 changed. All thirteen are nonlegendary and Sheep is nonlegendary, so false.
HandleEntityChange 0x060137af creates TagDeltaList before applying the new tags, deactivates custom keyword effects, destroys prior CardDef-owned effects, and calls LoadCard with async=false.

Entity.OnCardDefLoaded 0x06013875 passes updateActor=false to Card.SetCardDef 0x06012d22; that calls existing Actor.SetCardDef then UpdateAllComponents(true). It does not replace/destroy the actor or reset its status Spell table.

The callback skips UpdateActor and ActivateStateSpells when both flags are false. It marks m_loadState=3 before returning. HandleEntityChange then dispatches the collected tag deltas via OnTagsChanged.

production_contract.no_rules_changes: Do not modify historical transform mechanics or RNG; this is presentation-only binding.
production_contract.no_wait_for_old_taunt: Do not use the actual-actor-path-replacement coroutine or delay new Sheep visuals for its taunt callback. That coroutine is not reached for these thirteen mappings.
production_contract.reuse_lookup: Find a mappings row with exact from_card_id and to_card_id. Do not extend this rule to future identities without source audit.
production_contract.visible_transform: Preserve Actor/root and status identity. Refresh portrait/stat fields, retire only frozen and taunt via genuine source Death if their booleans were cleared, keep sleep if predicate unchanged.

actor_reuse.scope: Only current normal nonpremium thirteen minion identities transforming to CS2_tk1. Both sides, same board slot/controller/entity identity. No unsupported modern/alternate frames.
source_path_chain: Card.DetermineActorPathForZone 0x06012e9b -> ActorNames.GetZoneActor 0x060129e7 -> overload 0x060129e6, Play zone1 -> GetPlayActorByTags 0x060129f3.

Card type4 normal minion, not Lettuce, chooses actor kind7. GetNameWithPremiumType 0x060129fc selects s_actorAssets for premium0. ActorNames..cctor 0x06012a02 IL0067..006d binds kind7 to the identical Card_Play_Ally GUID.

The CardDef portrait/material/class changes do not define a different standard play Actor path. Same Actor holds the new CardDef via Actor.SetCardDef 0x06012807; normal UpdateAllComponents 0x0601285e updates text/materials/textures/mesh without ReleaseSpells.

state_decisions.corruption: Remove gameplay corruption marking per existing historical transform rules; no persistent source skull/status asset or extra status sound is introduced.
state_decisions.frozen: If FROZEN260 1->0, dispatch ordinary type14 Death on the same status instance and run the recovered thaw audio. No minion-death 0.3 phase delay; transformation is a tag change.
state_decisions.hidden: An unrelated actual temporary Actor.Hide still gates tag visual dispatch, as described in hidden_actor_semantics.json. Do not infer that Polymorph causes a Hide: the recovered CS2_022 start/impact routes contain no target Actor.Hide/Show action.
state_decisions.sleep: Current rules preserve summoning_sick and attacks_used; all thirteen source minions and Sheep lack Charge. Thus IsAsleep predicate remains unchanged. Preserve existing sleep instance/serial/timeline and only update its subject card ID/portrait binding. Do not emit Death/Birth merely because the card ID changed.
state_decisions.taunt: If TAUNT190 1->0, TagVisualConfiguration.ActivateStateFunction(TAUNT,false) 0x06014baf IL006c..0072 calls no-argument Actor.DeactivateTaunt 0x06012952, which checks active type8 and calls ActivateSpellDeathState at IL000b. Run the recovered shield-break audio once. No replacement-only callback/wait branch.
state_decisions.unchanged: No lifecycle event solely from card ID changes. Preserve status roots not removed by real tag/predicate changes.

tag_delta_dispatch: HandleEntityChange 0x060137af: CreateDeltas IL000c -> SetTags IL0019 -> LoadCard(async=false) IL0053 -> OnTagsChanged IL0102.

Entity.OnTagsChanged 0x060137a2 -> Card.OnTagsChanged 0x06012d77. Non-stat tags FROZEN260/TAUNT190/NUM_TURNS271 dispatch Card.OnTagChanged 0x06012d7b, whose IL001b calls TagVisualConfiguration.ProcessTagChange.

ProcessTagChange 0x06014bac uses source m_TagRemoved when old!=0,new==0. The relevant config entries have m_IgnoreCanShowActorVisuals=0. The synchronous CardDef loading callback has completed, so an otherwise shown target passes the gate.

update_actor_parameter_proof.same_path_gate: An existing non-LettuceAbilityActor with m_actorPath==resolvedActorPath returns at IL005a before prefab instantiation or old-actor cleanup.

change_entity_chain: Entity.OnChangeEntity 0x06013799 constructs LoadCardData(updateActor=ShouldUpdateActorOnChangeEntity, restartStateSpells=ShouldRestartStateSpellsOnChangeEntity, fromChangeEntity=true).

ShouldUpdateActorOnChangeEntity 0x0601379c returns true only on CARDTYPE202/PREMIUM12/LETTUCE_MERCENARY1665 changes or signature frame change. All thirteen current normal minions to normal Sheep keep these values; SignatureFrameWillChange 0x0601379b returns false unless premium==3.

ShouldRestartStateSpellsOnChangeEntity 0x0601379d special Battleground enemy coin gate is absent; ordinary fallback is ELITE114 changed. All thirteen are nonlegendary and Sheep is nonlegendary, so false.
HandleEntityChange 0x060137af creates TagDeltaList before applying the new tags, deactivates custom keyword effects, destroys prior CardDef-owned effects, and calls LoadCard with async=false.

Entity.OnCardDefLoaded 0x06013875 passes updateActor=false to Card.SetCardDef 0x06012d22; that calls existing Actor.SetCardDef then UpdateAllComponents(true). It does not replace/destroy the actor or reset its status Spell table.

The callback skips UpdateActor and ActivateStateSpells when both flags are false. It marks m_loadState=3 before returning. HandleEntityChange then dispatches the collected tag deltas via OnTagsChanged.

production_contract.no_rules_changes: Do not modify historical transform mechanics or RNG; this is presentation-only binding.
production_contract.no_wait_for_old_taunt: Do not use the actual-actor-path-replacement coroutine or delay new Sheep visuals for its taunt callback. That coroutine is not reached for these thirteen mappings.
production_contract.reuse_lookup: Find a mappings row with exact from_card_id and to_card_id. Do not extend this rule to future identities without source audit.
production_contract.visible_transform: Preserve Actor/root and status identity. Refresh portrait/stat fields, retire only frozen and taunt via genuine source Death if their booleans were cleared, keep sleep if predicate unchanged.

actor_reuse.scope: Only current normal nonpremium thirteen minion identities transforming to CS2_tk1. Both sides, same board slot/controller/entity identity. No unsupported modern/alternate frames.
source_path_chain: Card.DetermineActorPathForZone 0x06012e9b -> ActorNames.GetZoneActor 0x060129e7 -> overload 0x060129e6, Play zone1 -> GetPlayActorByTags 0x060129f3.

Card type4 normal minion, not Lettuce, chooses actor kind7. GetNameWithPremiumType 0x060129fc selects s_actorAssets for premium0. ActorNames..cctor 0x06012a02 IL0067..006d binds kind7 to the identical Card_Play_Ally GUID.

The CardDef portrait/material/class changes do not define a different standard play Actor path. Same Actor holds the new CardDef via Actor.SetCardDef 0x06012807; normal UpdateAllComponents 0x0601285e updates text/materials/textures/mesh without ReleaseSpells.

state_decisions.corruption: Remove gameplay corruption marking per existing historical transform rules; no persistent source skull/status asset or extra status sound is introduced.
state_decisions.frozen: If FROZEN260 1->0, dispatch ordinary type14 Death on the same status instance and run the recovered thaw audio. No minion-death 0.3 phase delay; transformation is a tag change.
state_decisions.hidden: An unrelated actual temporary Actor.Hide still gates tag visual dispatch, as described in hidden_actor_semantics.json. Do not infer that Polymorph causes a Hide: the recovered CS2_022 start/impact routes contain no target Actor.Hide/Show action.
state_decisions.sleep: Current rules preserve summoning_sick and attacks_used; all thirteen source minions and Sheep lack Charge. Thus IsAsleep predicate remains unchanged. Preserve existing sleep instance/serial/timeline and only update its subject card ID/portrait binding. Do not emit Death/Birth merely because the card ID changed.
state_decisions.taunt: If TAUNT190 1->0, TagVisualConfiguration.ActivateStateFunction(TAUNT,false) 0x06014baf IL006c..0072 calls no-argument Actor.DeactivateTaunt 0x06012952, which checks active type8 and calls ActivateSpellDeathState at IL000b. Run the recovered shield-break audio once. No replacement-only callback/wait branch.
state_decisions.unchanged: No lifecycle event solely from card ID changes. Preserve status roots not removed by real tag/predicate changes.

tag_delta_dispatch: HandleEntityChange 0x060137af: CreateDeltas IL000c -> SetTags IL0019 -> LoadCard(async=false) IL0053 -> OnTagsChanged IL0102.

Entity.OnTagsChanged 0x060137a2 -> Card.OnTagsChanged 0x06012d77. Non-stat tags FROZEN260/TAUNT190/NUM_TURNS271 dispatch Card.OnTagChanged 0x06012d7b, whose IL001b calls TagVisualConfiguration.ProcessTagChange.

ProcessTagChange 0x06014bac uses source m_TagRemoved when old!=0,new==0. The relevant config entries have m_IgnoreCanShowActorVisuals=0. The synchronous CardDef loading callback has completed, so an otherwise shown target passes the gate.

update_actor_parameter_proof.same_path_gate: An existing non-LettuceAbilityActor with m_actorPath==resolvedActorPath returns at IL005a before prefab instantiation or old-actor cleanup.

change_entity_chain: Entity.OnChangeEntity 0x06013799 constructs LoadCardData(updateActor=ShouldUpdateActorOnChangeEntity, restartStateSpells=ShouldRestartStateSpellsOnChangeEntity, fromChangeEntity=true).

ShouldUpdateActorOnChangeEntity 0x0601379c returns true only on CARDTYPE202/PREMIUM12/LETTUCE_MERCENARY1665 changes or signature frame change. All thirteen current normal minions to normal Sheep keep these values; SignatureFrameWillChange 0x0601379b returns false unless premium==3.

ShouldRestartStateSpellsOnChangeEntity 0x0601379d special Battleground enemy coin gate is absent; ordinary fallback is ELITE114 changed. All thirteen are nonlegendary and Sheep is nonlegendary, so false.
HandleEntityChange 0x060137af creates TagDeltaList before applying the new tags, deactivates custom keyword effects, destroys prior CardDef-owned effects, and calls LoadCard with async=false.

Entity.OnCardDefLoaded 0x06013875 passes updateActor=false to Card.SetCardDef 0x06012d22; that calls existing Actor.SetCardDef then UpdateAllComponents(true). It does not replace/destroy the actor or reset its status Spell table.

The callback skips UpdateActor and ActivateStateSpells when both flags are false. It marks m_loadState=3 before returning. HandleEntityChange then dispatches the collected tag deltas via OnTagsChanged.

production_contract.no_rules_changes: Do not modify historical transform mechanics or RNG; this is presentation-only binding.
production_contract.no_wait_for_old_taunt: Do not use the actual-actor-path-replacement coroutine or delay new Sheep visuals for its taunt callback. That coroutine is not reached for these thirteen mappings.
production_contract.reuse_lookup: Find a mappings row with exact from_card_id and to_card_id. Do not extend this rule to future identities without source audit.
production_contract.visible_transform: Preserve Actor/root and status identity. Refresh portrait/stat fields, retire only frozen and taunt via genuine source Death if their booleans were cleared, keep sleep if predicate unchanged.

actor_reuse.scope: Only current normal nonpremium thirteen minion identities transforming to CS2_tk1. Both sides, same board slot/controller/entity identity. No unsupported modern/alternate frames.
source_path_chain: Card.DetermineActorPathForZone 0x06012e9b -> ActorNames.GetZoneActor 0x060129e7 -> overload 0x060129e6, Play zone1 -> GetPlayActorByTags 0x060129f3.

Card type4 normal minion, not Lettuce, chooses actor kind7. GetNameWithPremiumType 0x060129fc selects s_actorAssets for premium0. ActorNames..cctor 0x06012a02 IL0067..006d binds kind7 to the identical Card_Play_Ally GUID.

The CardDef portrait/material/class changes do not define a different standard play Actor path. Same Actor holds the new CardDef via Actor.SetCardDef 0x06012807; normal UpdateAllComponents 0x0601285e updates text/materials/textures/mesh without ReleaseSpells.

state_decisions.corruption: Remove gameplay corruption marking per existing historical transform rules; no persistent source skull/status asset or extra status sound is introduced.
state_decisions.frozen: If FROZEN260 1->0, dispatch ordinary type14 Death on the same status instance and run the recovered thaw audio. No minion-death 0.3 phase delay; transformation is a tag change.
state_decisions.hidden: An unrelated actual temporary Actor.Hide still gates tag visual dispatch, as described in hidden_actor_semantics.json. Do not infer that Polymorph causes a Hide: the recovered CS2_022 start/impact routes contain no target Actor.Hide/Show action.
state_decisions.sleep: Current rules preserve summoning_sick and attacks_used; all thirteen source minions and Sheep lack Charge. Thus IsAsleep predicate remains unchanged. Preserve existing sleep instance/serial/timeline and only update its subject card ID/portrait binding. Do not emit Death/Birth merely because the card ID changed.
state_decisions.taunt: If TAUNT190 1->0, TagVisualConfiguration.ActivateStateFunction(TAUNT,false) 0x06014baf IL006c..0072 calls no-argument Actor.DeactivateTaunt 0x06012952, which checks active type8 and calls ActivateSpellDeathState at IL000b. Run the recovered shield-break audio once. No replacement-only callback/wait branch.
state_decisions.unchanged: No lifecycle event solely from card ID changes. Preserve status roots not removed by real tag/predicate changes.

tag_delta_dispatch: HandleEntityChange 0x060137af: CreateDeltas IL000c -> SetTags IL0019 -> LoadCard(async=false) IL0053 -> OnTagsChanged IL0102.

Entity.OnTagsChanged 0x060137a2 -> Card.OnTagsChanged 0x06012d77. Non-stat tags FROZEN260/TAUNT190/NUM_TURNS271 dispatch Card.OnTagChanged 0x06012d7b, whose IL001b calls TagVisualConfiguration.ProcessTagChange.

renderer.validation: Source GPU draft. CPU equations/projection independently verified; actual GPU targets/order/raster/quantization require QA capture.

change_entity_chain: Entity.OnChangeEntity 0x06013799 constructs LoadCardData(updateActor=ShouldUpdateActorOnChangeEntity, restartStateSpells=ShouldRestartStateSpellsOnChangeEntity, fromChangeEntity=true).

ShouldUpdateActorOnChangeEntity 0x0601379c returns true only on CARDTYPE202/PREMIUM12/LETTUCE_MERCENARY1665 changes or signature frame change. All thirteen current normal minions to normal Sheep keep these values; SignatureFrameWillChange 0x0601379b returns false unless premium==3.

ShouldRestartStateSpellsOnChangeEntity 0x0601379d special Battleground enemy coin gate is absent; ordinary fallback is ELITE114 changed. All thirteen are nonlegendary and Sheep is nonlegendary, so false.
HandleEntityChange 0x060137af creates TagDeltaList before applying the new tags, deactivates custom keyword effects, destroys prior CardDef-owned effects, and calls LoadCard with async=false.

Entity.OnCardDefLoaded 0x06013875 passes updateActor=false to Card.SetCardDef 0x06012d22; that calls existing Actor.SetCardDef then UpdateAllComponents(true). It does not replace/destroy the actor or reset its status Spell table.

The callback skips UpdateActor and ActivateStateSpells when both flags are false. It marks m_loadState=3 before returning. HandleEntityChange then dispatches the collected tag deltas via OnTagsChanged.

production_contract.no_rules_changes: Do not modify historical transform mechanics or RNG; this is presentation-only binding.
production_contract.no_wait_for_old_taunt: Do not use the actual-actor-path-replacement coroutine or delay new Sheep visuals for its taunt callback. That coroutine is not reached for these thirteen mappings.
production_contract.reuse_lookup: Find a mappings row with exact from_card_id and to_card_id. Do not extend this rule to future identities without source audit.
production_contract.visible_transform: Preserve Actor/root and status identity. Refresh portrait/stat fields, retire only frozen and taunt via genuine source Death if their booleans were cleared, keep sleep if predicate unchanged.

actor_reuse.scope: Only current normal nonpremium thirteen minion identities transforming to CS2_tk1. Both sides, same board slot/controller/entity identity. No unsupported modern/alternate frames.
source_path_chain: Card.DetermineActorPathForZone 0x06012e9b -> ActorNames.GetZoneActor 0x060129e7 -> overload 0x060129e6, Play zone1 -> GetPlayActorByTags 0x060129f3.

Card type4 normal minion, not Lettuce, chooses actor kind7. GetNameWithPremiumType 0x060129fc selects s_actorAssets for premium0. ActorNames..cctor 0x06012a02 IL0067..006d binds kind7 to the identical Card_Play_Ally GUID.

The CardDef portrait/material/class changes do not define a different standard play Actor path. Same Actor holds the new CardDef via Actor.SetCardDef 0x06012807; normal UpdateAllComponents 0x0601285e updates text/materials/textures/mesh without ReleaseSpells.

state_decisions.corruption: Remove gameplay corruption marking per existing historical transform rules; no persistent source skull/status asset or extra status sound is introduced.
state_decisions.frozen: If FROZEN260 1->0, dispatch ordinary type14 Death on the same status instance and run the recovered thaw audio. No minion-death 0.3 phase delay; transformation is a tag change.
state_decisions.hidden: An unrelated actual temporary Actor.Hide still gates tag visual dispatch, as described in hidden_actor_semantics.json. Do not infer that Polymorph causes a Hide: the recovered CS2_022 start/impact routes contain no target Actor.Hide/Show action.
state_decisions.sleep: Current rules preserve summoning_sick and attacks_used; all thirteen source minions and Sheep lack Charge. Thus IsAsleep predicate remains unchanged. Preserve existing sleep instance/serial/timeline and only update its subject card ID/portrait binding. Do not emit Death/Birth merely because the card ID changed.
state_decisions.taunt: If TAUNT190 1->0, TagVisualConfiguration.ActivateStateFunction(TAUNT,false) 0x06014baf IL006c..0072 calls no-argument Actor.DeactivateTaunt 0x06012952, which checks active type8 and calls ActivateSpellDeathState at IL000b. Run the recovered shield-break audio once. No replacement-only callback/wait branch.
state_decisions.unchanged: No lifecycle event solely from card ID changes. Preserve status roots not removed by real tag/predicate changes.

tag_delta_dispatch: HandleEntityChange 0x060137af: CreateDeltas IL000c -> SetTags IL0019 -> LoadCard(async=false) IL0053 -> OnTagsChanged IL0102.

Entity.OnTagsChanged 0x060137a2 -> Card.OnTagsChanged 0x06012d77. Non-stat tags FROZEN260/TAUNT190/NUM_TURNS271 dispatch Card.OnTagChanged 0x06012d7b, whose IL001b calls TagVisualConfiguration.ProcessTagChange.

ProcessTagChange 0x06014bac uses source m_TagRemoved when old!=0,new==0. The relevant config entries have m_IgnoreCanShowActorVisuals=0. The synchronous CardDef loading callback has completed, so an otherwise shown target passes the gate.

update_actor_parameter_proof.same_path_gate: An existing non-LettuceAbilityActor with m_actorPath==resolvedActorPath returns at IL005a before prefab instantiation or old-actor cleanup.

change_entity_chain: Entity.OnChangeEntity 0x06013799 constructs LoadCardData(updateActor=ShouldUpdateActorOnChangeEntity, restartStateSpells=ShouldRestartStateSpellsOnChangeEntity, fromChangeEntity=true).

ShouldUpdateActorOnChangeEntity 0x0601379c returns true only on CARDTYPE202/PREMIUM12/LETTUCE_MERCENARY1665 changes or signature frame change. All thirteen current normal minions to normal Sheep keep these values; SignatureFrameWillChange 0x0601379b returns false unless premium==3.

ShouldRestartStateSpellsOnChangeEntity 0x0601379d special Battleground enemy coin gate is absent; ordinary fallback is ELITE114 changed. All thirteen are nonlegendary and Sheep is nonlegendary, so false.
HandleEntityChange 0x060137af creates TagDeltaList before applying the new tags, deactivates custom keyword effects, destroys prior CardDef-owned effects, and calls LoadCard with async=false.

Entity.OnCardDefLoaded 0x06013875 passes updateActor=false to Card.SetCardDef 0x06012d22; that calls existing Actor.SetCardDef then UpdateAllComponents(true). It does not replace/destroy the actor or reset its status Spell table.

The callback skips UpdateActor and ActivateStateSpells when both flags are false. It marks m_loadState=3 before returning. HandleEntityChange then dispatches the collected tag deltas via OnTagsChanged.

production_contract.no_rules_changes: Do not modify historical transform mechanics or RNG; this is presentation-only binding.
production_contract.no_wait_for_old_taunt: Do not use the actual-actor-path-replacement coroutine or delay new Sheep visuals for its taunt callback. That coroutine is not reached for these thirteen mappings.
production_contract.reuse_lookup: Find a mappings row with exact from_card_id and to_card_id. Do not extend this rule to future identities without source audit.
production_contract.visible_transform: Preserve Actor/root and status identity. Refresh portrait/stat fields, retire only frozen and taunt via genuine source Death if their booleans were cleared, keep sleep if predicate unchanged.

actor_reuse.scope: Only current normal nonpremium thirteen minion identities transforming to CS2_tk1. Both sides, same board slot/controller/entity identity. No unsupported modern/alternate frames.
source_path_chain: Card.DetermineActorPathForZone 0x06012e9b -> ActorNames.GetZoneActor 0x060129e7 -> overload 0x060129e6, Play zone1 -> GetPlayActorByTags 0x060129f3.

Card type4 normal minion, not Lettuce, chooses actor kind7. GetNameWithPremiumType 0x060129fc selects s_actorAssets for premium0. ActorNames..cctor 0x06012a02 IL0067..006d binds kind7 to the identical Card_Play_Ally GUID.

The CardDef portrait/material/class changes do not define a different standard play Actor path. Same Actor holds the new CardDef via Actor.SetCardDef 0x06012807; normal UpdateAllComponents 0x0601285e updates text/materials/textures/mesh without ReleaseSpells.

state_decisions.corruption: Remove gameplay corruption marking per existing historical transform rules; no persistent source skull/status asset or extra status sound is introduced.
state_decisions.frozen: If FROZEN260 1->0, dispatch ordinary type14 Death on the same status instance and run the recovered thaw audio. No minion-death 0.3 phase delay; transformation is a tag change.
state_decisions.hidden: An unrelated actual temporary Actor.Hide still gates tag visual dispatch, as described in hidden_actor_semantics.json. Do not infer that Polymorph causes a Hide: the recovered CS2_022 start/impact routes contain no target Actor.Hide/Show action.
state_decisions.sleep: Current rules preserve summoning_sick and attacks_used; all thirteen source minions and Sheep lack Charge. Thus IsAsleep predicate remains unchanged. Preserve existing sleep instance/serial/timeline and only update its subject card ID/portrait binding. Do not emit Death/Birth merely because the card ID changed.
state_decisions.taunt: If TAUNT190 1->0, TagVisualConfiguration.ActivateStateFunction(TAUNT,false) 0x06014baf IL006c..0072 calls no-argument Actor.DeactivateTaunt 0x06012952, which checks active type8 and calls ActivateSpellDeathState at IL000b. Run the recovered shield-break audio once. No replacement-only callback/wait branch.
state_decisions.unchanged: No lifecycle event solely from card ID changes. Preserve status roots not removed by real tag/predicate changes.

tag_delta_dispatch: HandleEntityChange 0x060137af: CreateDeltas IL000c -> SetTags IL0019 -> LoadCard(async=false) IL0053 -> OnTagsChanged IL0102.

Entity.OnTagsChanged 0x060137a2 -> Card.OnTagsChanged 0x06012d77. Non-stat tags FROZEN260/TAUNT190/NUM_TURNS271 dispatch Card.OnTagChanged 0x06012d7b, whose IL001b calls TagVisualConfiguration.ProcessTagChange.

ProcessTagChange 0x06014bac uses source m_TagRemoved when old!=0,new==0. The relevant config entries have m_IgnoreCanShowActorVisuals=0. The synchronous CardDef loading callback has completed, so an otherwise shown target passes the gate.

update_actor_parameter_proof.same_path_gate: An existing non-LettuceAbilityActor with m_actorPath==resolvedActorPath returns at IL005a before prefab instantiation or old-actor cleanup.
